body:
CORRECTED IMPLEMENTATION ORDER (the report’s 1-10 order is too feature-linear and discovers authority/causality late):
WP0 Decision freeze: product claim (feasibility demo vs full two-mode MVP), staffing/schedule, secure default = public Stage + pre-auth private controller, separate sites, explicit Stage fullscreen click, private-default live candidates. Gate: named owner accepts cuts and numeric release thresholds.
WP1 Contracts + threat/fault harness: deck/public artifact schemas; role credentials; field authority; per-role streams; CAS binding/takeover; public-card causal envelope/tombstones; protocol/build compatibility. This must precede React/Supabase choices. Gate E0.
WP2 Parallel foundations: (A) two-site public prepared-deck vertical slice + noninterference E1; (B) coordinator persistence/restart/fault harness; (C) canonical ingestion corpus E4. Do not build UI around mock state contracts that may change.
WP3 One end-to-end prepared-evidence slice: upload -> immutable public artifact -> phone controller -> Stage bind -> absolute slide set -> receipt -> pre-approved card publish/withdraw -> event log/replay. Gate E2 plus exact projector run. This retires all high-risk cross-domain/state coupling before AI.
WP4 Display mode QA: same protocol for Extend/Duplicate/single screen; topology affects instructions only. Manual placement/fullscreen first; co-resident Console is optional and loses secure claim on any Duplicate-switch leak. Gate E3.
WP5 Audio consent/lifecycle + STT provider adapter/bake-off and causal fusion. Gate E5. STT provider remains replaceable until corpus results.
WP6 Retrieval/verifier private-only: ACL-first internal retrieval, SSRF-safe external fetch, deterministic fields, rights/DLP, abstention. Gate E6. Do not yet wire public button.
WP7 Publication UX/value gates: three-axis status and active-controller approval, only after candidates have full causal envelope. Run E7; public live flag stays off unless precision and cognitive-load gates pass.
WP8 Enhancements after core release: Window Management auto-placement E8, coaching, immutable reports. Event log is already present; report projection can now be deterministic.
WP9 Full release matrix/security review/load/accessibility/deletion receipts/SW cohort rollout.
IRREVERSIBLE ENOUGH: implementation may start once WP0/1 decisions and schemas are frozen, E1 establishes the boundary, coordinator primitive passes restart/CAS tests, and canonical artifact identity is accepted. Vendor choices, Window API, STT, OCR/VLM, and live-public AI deliberately remain reversible adapters/flags.
summary: Corrected implementation order and irreversible gates
